def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    color = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0), 0)
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != color or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            minr, maxr = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            minc, maxc = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            comps.append((maxr-minr+1, maxc-minc+1, cells, minr, minc))
    _, _, cells, minr, minc = next(c for c in comps if c[0] == c[1])
    height = max(r for r,c in cells)-minr+1
    width = max(c for r,c in cells)-minc+1
    out = [[0]*width for _ in range(height)]
    for r,c in cells:
        out[r-minr][c-minc] = color
    return out
